task.description: Produce a backend design artefact for ADP-04b at src/design/adp-04b-tenant-realm-binding.md. Define additive tenant schema updates for realm binding: tenant.idp_realm_id TEXT NULL with migration behavior that sets the default tenant (00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000) to bpm-default while preserving existing rows. Specify create/update service and repository contracts that require idp_realm_id for non-default tenant creation once OIDC is enabled, including validation boundaries and failure modes. Include invariants linking tenant realm ownership to ADP-04a external identity linkage and OIDC-12/OIDC-14 realm lifecycle behavior. Design only; no implementation edits.
acceptance_criteria: Design defines additive ADP-04b schema column semantics with backward compatibility
Migration/backfill behavior for default tenant realm assignment is explicit and testable
Tenant creation/update contracts define when idp_realm_id is required and how validation errors surface
Traceability maps ADP-04b behavior to ADP-04, ADP-04a, OIDC-12, and OIDC-14
Design includes concrete testability notes for default-tenant regression and OIDC-enabled tenant creation rules

result.summary: Design artefact for ADP-04b tenant realm binding with additive schema semantics, explicit default-tenant migration/backfill behavior, OIDC-enabled tenant create/update validation boundaries, and ADP-04a/OIDC lifecycle invariants.
